What will Google do to compete with ChatGPT?

Michael SpencerJan 13, 2023∙ Paid4Share

Hey Everyone, 

While ChatGPT has the limelight thanks to OpenAI and Microsoft, in 2023 we’ll see the emergence of other chatbots that may be able to challenge viral ChatGPT, especially in the A.I. alignment trust & safety areas. 

So who might be the competitors in 2023 or 2024 of ChatGPT, now likely to get $10 billion more funding from Microsoft’s pending deal with OpenAI? 

Let’s cover some formative ground here that’s likely important about how A.I. and Conversational A.I. in particular will evolve in 2023.
